decision_to_unlock: Use observed queries and page-level impressions/clicks on official professional-service routes to preserve route distinctions and decide whether any further page-level performance evidence can be obtained without paid access.
finding: A 27-day read-only Google Search Console extraction for the ten official professional-service route URLs returned 1,256 impressions and 48 clicks. A separate query-level extraction returned 122 rows; 17 selected examples are preserved. The attempt to retrieve a one-year range was blocked by the current Windsor.ai trial history limit. A same-period GA4 extraction for those ten landing paths returned no rows; this is not interpreted as zero traffic. None of the seven legacy GitHub Pages answer URLs were measured.
evidence: Existing Windsor.ai read-only Search Console and GA4 connections
limitations: Only the 27-day date range 2026-10-22 to 2026-11-17 was accessible.
Search Console page-level totals cover ten official service URLs only; not all property URLs.
Query-level observations are a separate extraction and are not summed to reconcile the page aggregate.
No legacy GitHub Pages URL, redirect, AI citation, form conversion or qualified enquiry was measured.
GA4 returned an empty response for the requested landing-page extraction; no zero-traffic inference is made.
No paid plan upgrade or purchase was performed.
next_decision: Keep all seven legacy URLs stable; use this as contextual evidence for official route relevance, not as a basis for redirects or page consolidation.
